newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-OpCo explains Access Health.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-OpCo explains Access Health.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co analyst Sally Yanchus said she initiated coverage of Access Health Inc as buy rating.
-- estimated earnings of $0.84 for the 1997 year, ending in September, and $1.17 for 1998, compared to $0.23 for 1996.
-- said stock is "way, way undervalued, and has been sold off in the last couple of months."
-- growth "looks great...They bought the second biggest competitor ( Informed Access Systems ), making them the dominant player in their market now."
-- was optimistic about new management that took over earlier this month.
-- co provides medical advice on the telephone to HMO patients.
-- set 12-month price target of $35. Shares rose 1/2 to 13.
